main.summary: Download session that persists local state and retrieves ranges from DataControl.

field.name: client
field.summary: The DataControl client used to issue segmented or stream transfer service calls.

field.name: storage
field.summary: The local working directory storage that persists segmented or stream download state and content.

field.name: token
field.summary: The optional bearer token used for authenticated service calls.

field.name: CompletionMode
field.summary: The configured completion behavior used by one-call stream-follow helpers.

field.name: MaxBytes
field.summary: The optional byte limit applied by bounded stream-follow completion helpers.

field.name: FollowStream
field.summary: The optional buffered follow stream used for stream-follow downloads.

field.name: FollowSubscription
field.summary: The optional persistent follow notification subscription owned for the lifetime of this download session object.

field.name: disposed
field.summary: Tracks whether the download session has already released its owned resources.

constructor.name: Constructor
constructor.summary: Create a client-side download session wrapper.
constructor.param: The DataControl client used for service calls.
The local working directory storage for the session.
Optional bearer token used for authenticated service calls.
The current persisted session metadata and transfer state.
Configured completion behavior for stream-follow downloads.
Optional maximum number of bytes the stream-follow helper should realize before stopping.
Optional buffered follow stream used for stream-follow downloads.
Optional live item being downloaded in the session.
Optional persistent follow notification subscription owned by the session for its object lifetime.

property.name: Session
property.summary: Gets the current local download session metadata and transfer state snapshot.

property.name: LiveItem
property.summary: Gets the current live item being downloaded in the session, if any.

method.name: Dispose
method.summary: Release the session-owned buffered follow stream and persistent follow notification subscription.

method.name: DisposeAsync
method.summary: Asynchronously release the session-owned persistent follow notification subscription and any buffered follow stream resources.
method.returns: A value task that completes when the session-owned resources have been released.

method.name: WaitForFollowWakeAsync
method.summary: Wait for a wake signal from the session-owned persistent follow notification subscription, or fall back to a direct delay when the session has no subscription mapping.
method.param: Wait duration to apply for the current follow wait cycle.
Cancellation Token.
method.returns: A task that completes when the session receives a wake signal, the fallback delay elapses, or cancellation is requested.

method.name: DownloadNext
method.summary: Download the next planned missing range into the local working directory and refresh persisted state.
method.param: Cancellation Token.
method.returns: A task that completes with true when a segment download succeeds and local state is refreshed; otherwise false.

method.name: DownloadSegmentNext
method.summary: Download the next planned finite segmented range into the local working directory and return the exact range realized for progress reporting.
method.param: Cancellation Token.
method.returns: A task that completes with the exact segmented range downloaded and persisted locally, or null when no segmented download can be performed or the operation does not succeed.

method.name: ReOpenSegmentedFollowSession
method.summary: Re-open a segmented follow download session against the current committed stream identity and persist the refreshed follow state while preserving already realized local ranges.
method.param: The current segmented follow transfer state whose committed stream identity and realized local ranges must be preserved across the re-open call.
Cancellation Token.
method.returns: A task that completes after the refreshed follow state has been persisted locally, or returns without changes when the re-open call does not produce a compatible state.

method.name: DownloadToCompletion
method.summary: Download remaining finite ranges or stream-follow extents until the session reaches its configured stopping condition or the source session reaches a terminal state.
method.param: Optional progress receiver notified after each successfully downloaded finite segment or stream extent.
Cancellation Token.
method.returns: A task that completes with the number of successfully downloaded finite segments or stream extents.

method.name: DownloadToCurrent
method.summary: Download remaining finite ranges or stream-follow extents that are currently available, then return without waiting for the source session to reach a terminal state.
method.param: Optional progress receiver notified after each successfully downloaded finite segment or stream extent.
Optional wait duration to use when no additional data is currently available. Use to avoid waiting.
Cancellation Token.
method.returns: A task that completes with the number of successfully downloaded finite segments or stream extents materialized during the catch-up pass.

method.name: DownloadCore
method.summary: Run the shared segmented and stream follow download loop used by both terminal completion and catch-up-to-current entry points.
method.param: Optional progress receiver notified after each successful download.
Wait duration used when additional follow data is not currently available. keeps waiting until terminal conditions or cancellation, while disables waiting.
Cancellation Token.
method.returns: A task that completes with the number of successfully downloaded finite segments or stream extents.

method.name: Materialize
method.summary: Materialize the downloaded item from the local working-directory session state when the session has sufficient local content for the active transfer family.
method.param: Cancellation Token.
method.returns: A task that completes with the materialized download result, or null when the local state is incomplete or invalid.

method.name: MaterializeWithDestination
method.summary: Materialize the downloaded item and, when a destination directory is supplied, export both materialized files into that directory before retiring the local session state.
method.param: Optional destination directory for the materialized object and stream files. When omitted, the materialized item remains bound to the session-managed files in the local working directory.
Cancellation Token.
method.returns: A task that completes with the materialized download result, or null when the local state is incomplete, invalid, or cannot be safely exported.
method.remarks: Supplying a destination directory performs a one-way export of the object payload and stream file. Active stream-follow sessions may refuse export until the stream becomes terminal.

method.name: DeleteLocalState
method.summary: Delete the local working directory state for the current download session without contacting the service.
method.param: Cancellation Token.
method.returns: A task that completes with true when the local session state directory is deleted successfully; otherwise false.

method.name: RemoveTransfer
method.summary: Remove the retained remote download transfer session and delete the corresponding local working directory state.
method.param: Cancellation Token.
method.returns: A task that completes with true when the remote removal succeeds and local state is removed; otherwise false.

method.name: Abort
method.summary: Abort the remote download session and delete the corresponding local working directory state.
method.param: Cancellation Token.
method.returns: A task that completes with true when the remote abort succeeds and local state is removed; otherwise false.

method.name: CreateProgress
method.summary: Create a transfer progress snapshot for a completed downloaded range.
method.param: The refreshed transfer state after the successful download.
The range that was most recently downloaded.
method.returns: A progress snapshot describing the updated download state.

method.name: CreateStreamProgress
method.summary: Create a transfer progress snapshot for a completed downloaded stream extent.
method.param: The refreshed stream transfer state after the successful download.
The footer describing the most recently downloaded stream extent.
method.returns: A progress snapshot describing the updated stream-follow state.

method.name: DownloadStreamNext
method.summary: Download the next available stream-follow extent into the local stream working directory and refresh persisted stream state.
method.param: Cancellation Token.
method.returns: A task that completes with true when a stream extent download succeeds and local state is refreshed; otherwise false.

method.name: MaterializeStream
method.summary: Materialize the current stream-follow item view from the local stream working directory, or export both files to a destination directory when the stream session is eligible for terminal export.
method.param: Optional destination directory for the materialized object and stream files.
Cancellation Token.
method.returns: A task that completes with the materialized stream download result, or null when the local state is incomplete or invalid.

method.name: BindMaterializedStreamPath
method.summary: Bind the resolved local materialized stream file path onto the downloaded item using the appropriate item-type-specific file binding behavior.
method.param: The downloaded item instance being materialized from the local session working directory.
The resolved local materialized file path for the downloaded stream content.
True when the materialized stream file is the authoritative content source.
Cancellation Token.
method.returns: A task that completes with true when the item successfully binds or rebinds to the local materialized stream file path; otherwise false.

method.name: VerifyMaterializationAsync
method.summary: Verify the local materialized object payload and optional stream payload against the expected published integrity values, or skip the work after the session has already completed one successful verification pass.
method.param: Expected SHA-512 of the serialized committed object payload.
Optional expected SHA-512 of the committed stream payload.
Expected realized stream length in bytes.
Local serialized object payload bytes loaded from working-directory state.
Local materialized stream file path to validate.
Cancellation Token.
method.returns: A task that completes with true when the local materialized content satisfies the expected published integrity contract; otherwise false.

method.name: VerifyObjectPayloadAsync
method.summary: Verify the local serialized object payload bytes against the expected published object hash.
method.param: Expected SHA-512 of the serialized committed object payload.
Local serialized object payload bytes loaded from working-directory state.
Cancellation Token.
method.returns: A task that completes with true when the local serialized object payload matches the expected published object hash; otherwise false.

method.name: VerifyStreamPayloadAsync
method.summary: Verify the local materialized stream file length and, when available, its full published stream hash.
method.param: Optional expected SHA-512 of the committed stream payload.
Expected realized stream length in bytes.
Local materialized stream file path to validate.
Cancellation Token.
method.returns: A task that completes with true when the local materialized stream satisfies the expected length and any available full-stream hash requirement; otherwise false.

method.name: PlanNextDownloadLength
method.summary: Plan the next stream-follow extent length using the effective preferred segment size, the currently available remote bytes, and any configured maximum byte allowance.
method.param: The refreshed stream-follow state.
Current realized local stream length before the next download request.
Number of bytes currently available from the source beyond the realized local length.
method.returns: The number of bytes to request in the next stream-follow segment download, or zero when no additional bytes should be requested.

method.name: EnsureExportPossible
method.summary: Check whether a materialized file can be exported to the requested target directory without colliding with another managed materialized file or an existing destination file.
method.param: Current session-managed materialized file path.
Requested export directory.
Optional preferred path whose file name should be preserved for the exported file.
Other managed paths that must not collide with the export target.
method.returns: True when the export target can be used safely; otherwise false.

method.name: ResolveSessionMaterializedFilePath
method.summary: Resolve the effective session-managed materialized file path for one local session file and move it inside the session directory when the preferred file name differs.
method.param: Session directory that should own the managed materialized file.
Current session-managed materialized file path.
Optional preferred path whose file name should be preserved.
Cancellation Token.
Other managed paths that must not collide with the resolved session target.
method.returns: A task that completes with the resulting session-managed materialized file path.

method.name: ExportMaterializedFile
method.summary: Copy a session-managed materialized file into the requested export directory while preserving the preferred file name when one is available.
method.param: Current session-managed materialized file path.
Requested export directory.
Optional preferred path whose file name should be preserved.
Cancellation Token.
Other managed paths that must not collide with the export target.
method.returns: A task that completes with the exported file path.

method.name: CanExportMaterializedPath
method.summary: Check whether a materialized file can be exported to a target path without collisions and while obtaining an exclusive lock on the current file.
method.param: Current materialized file path.
Requested export path.
method.returns: True when the current file can be safely reused or exported; otherwise false.

method.name: GetMaterializedTargetPath
method.summary: Build the target materialized file path using the requested directory and the preferred file name when one is available.
method.param: Current materialized file path.
Target directory for the materialized file.
Optional preferred stored path whose file name should be preserved.
method.returns: Resolved target materialized file path.

method.name: AreSamePath
method.summary: Determine whether two file paths refer to the same location, ignoring case differences.
method.param: The first file path to compare.
The second file path to compare.
method.returns: True when the paths refer to the same location; otherwise false.

method.name: PathsMatch
method.summary: Determine whether two file paths match.
method.param: The current file path to compare.
The target file path to compare.
method.returns: True when the paths refer to the same location; otherwise false.

method.name: IsFaultedOrAborted
method.summary: Determine whether a segmented download state has reached an aborted or faulted terminal condition.
method.param: The segmented download state to inspect.
method.returns: True when the segmented download state is aborted or faulted; otherwise false.

method.name: IsCommittedSegmentedTerminal
method.summary: Determine whether a committed segmented download state is terminal because no local missing ranges remain.
method.param: The segmented download state to inspect.
method.returns: True when the download has been promoted to committed mode and all missing ranges have been realized locally; otherwise false.

method.name: IsCaughtUpStagedFollow
method.summary: Determine whether a staged-follow segmented download is locally caught up to the currently available source extent.
method.param: The segmented download state to inspect.
method.returns: True when the download remains in staged-follow mode and has no missing ranges at the moment; otherwise false.

method.name: NeedsCommittedPromotion
method.summary: Determine whether a staged-follow segmented download has observed source commit and should keep reopening until the session promotes to committed mode.
method.param: The segmented download state to inspect.
method.returns: True when the download is still in staged-follow mode while its status reflects source commit; otherwise false.

method.name: CanWaitForStagedFollowData
method.summary: Determine whether a staged-follow segmented download is eligible to wait for additional data or a commit transition.
method.param: The segmented download state to inspect.
Whether the caller requested follow waiting.
method.returns: True when the session is still in staged-follow mode, waiting is enabled, and the state is not complete, aborted, or faulted; otherwise false.

method.name: ShouldStopCaughtUpStagedFollow
method.summary: Determine whether a staged-follow segmented download that is currently caught up should stop instead of waiting for additional source progress.
method.param: The segmented download state to inspect.
Whether the caller requested follow waiting.
method.returns: True when waiting is disabled or the state is already complete, aborted, or faulted; otherwise false.

method.name: ShouldContinueAfterStagedFollowReopen
method.summary: Determine whether the segmented follow loop should continue immediately after a promotion-aware reopen refresh.
method.param: The segmented download state to inspect.
method.returns: True when the refreshed state has become terminal, needs committed promotion handling, has newly available missing ranges, or has otherwise left the staged-follow caught-up waiting state; otherwise false.

method.name: PlanNextRange
method.summary: Plan the next download range from the first normalized missing range using the effective segment size policy.
method.param: The current download transfer state.
method.remarks: The algorithm starts from the first missing range. It then clamps the preferred segment size into the configured minimum and maximum bounds. If taking that planned prefix would leave behind a non-terminal tail smaller than the minimum segment size, the current request is reduced so the remaining tail grows back to at least the minimum size. When no split is needed, the original missing range is returned unchanged.
method.returns: The next range to download.

method.name: HasReachedConfiguredByteLimit
method.summary: Determine whether the current stream-follow download state has reached the configured maximum byte count.
method.param: The current stream-follow download state.
method.returns: True when a maximum byte count is configured and the appended length meets or exceeds it; otherwise false.
